description:
Get a food

One food: every nutrient per 100 g (energy, macronutrients, fats incl. saturated, trans, cholesterol and omega-3, sugars, fibre, sodium and salt, 9 minerals, 13 vitamins, caffeine) and its household portions with their weight (e.g. 1 medium tomato = 123 g). Use after a search when the user wants vitamins, minerals or a portion's weight.

GET /v1/nutrition/foods/{id} on Nutrition & Calories (SBX-BESIN). Costs 1 credit per call.
name: nutrition_getFood
title: Nutrition & Calories: Get a food
